projects.name: HDB E-Service Listing
highlights: Investigated and resolved production incidents within agreed SLA timelines, supporting service stability and timely incident closure.
Provided operational and technical support during housing sales launch periods.
Performed weekly post-deployment verification to validate application functionality and service stability.
Analyzed and responded to user enquiries on an ad hoc basis, investigating reported issues and providing appropriate resolutions or clarifications.

Developed and delivered two Service Requests (SRs) — the Family Care Scheme Joint Balloting enhancement and Subsidy Recovery Rate information enhancements for the Project Details and Watchlist modules — across the full SDLC.

projects.name: SSG Training Allowance System (TAS)
highlights: Developed and delivered four features across the Public and Agency Portals: Submit Application, Report Generation, Create Application, and Adjust Training Allowance.
Supported UAT by reviewing test steps and expected results, tracking findings in Jira, responding to user queries, and investigating and resolving reported defects.
Developed and delivered the Approval Workflow feature for the Agency Portal as part of Phase 2, following the successful rollout of Phase 1.

projects.name: eSub SR180 – CAM & CAP Onboarding
highlights: Implemented UI enhancements and collaborated with a backend developer to develop and test CAM onboarding changes based on technical specifications, including the migration from LDAP authentication to Keycloak Single Sign-On.

projects.name: MHA eMART2 GCC Migration
highlights: Tested and debugged migrated services in the new Government Commercial Cloud (GCC) environment in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
Remediated VAPT, Nexus IQ, and SonarQube findings arising from library upgrades within the existing codebase.
Executed performance testing using JMeter in the migrated GCC environment.
Supported PGP operations through ticket and email handling, implemented audit logging, and monitored DataSunrise database firewall events.
Developed and delivered the Multiple Active Persona Change Request (CR) in collaboration with the development team.
Updated existing technical specifications and user guides to support operational handover.
